weather_report:
As midnight drapes Boston in a shroud of humid fog, the air feels thick and expectant, alive with the promise of the storms that are soon to roll through. The forecast is insistent: showers and thunderstorms, heavy rains lurking in the distance, and gusts of wind battling to shake the city awake. It is a night that cradles both the whisper of the sea and the electric crackle of impending rain. The temperature hovers at a cool 56 degrees, setting the stage for a day that offers little more than a continuation of this overcast melancholy. 

As dawn rises, the fog will persist alongside sporadic showers, interspersed with moments of thunder that rumbled would shake your very core. The day will fail to fully awaken, remaining cloaked in a muted palette that mirrors the somber tones outside. For those who venture out, practicality is key; a sturdy raincoat and waterproof boots will serve well, while the embrace of a light sweater will keep the chill at bay. Given the tumultuous weather, indoor pursuits might beckon. A leisurely stroll through a nearby gallery could provide a welcome escape from the damp streets, or perhaps the warmth of a cozy café with the seductive aroma of brewing coffee and the turn of a page in a well-loved book. Under such conditions, taking the time to simply exist within the storm seems a wise choice, savoring the soothing sound of rain against the window as the world outside transforms.
